mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.signup_email_verification (email, secret_hash, expires_at) VALUES(#{email}, #{secretHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT verification_id, secret_hash, expires_at, used_at FROM public.signup_email_verification WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY created_at DESC, verification_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.signup_email_verification SET used_at = statement_timestamp() WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > statement_timestamp()
